bull_bear.body: Growth funded by mix of internal accruals, existing equity, and debt; INR 100 Cr rights issue raised (INR 35 Cr received in Jan 2026, balance in two calls); No dividend mentioned; Reinvestment into capacity and brand building.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body: Seasonality in ice cream (Q2/Q3 weakness); Input cost volatility for global commodities; Execution risk on capacity ramp-up; Competition from large FMCG players entering nuts segment; ESOP overhang (though FY27 cost expected < FY26).
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Confident, disciplined, and execution-focused; Emphasis on 'scale with profitability' rather than cash burn; Transparent on one-offs (ESOP) and seasonality.
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body: Ice cream division achieved PAT profitability in FY26 (vs planned FY27); Working capital cycles of nuts (peak in festive) and ice cream (peak in summer) are complementary, optimizing cash flow; 37,000 retail touchpoints of ice cream not yet fully leveraged for nuts cross-selling.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

bull_bear.body:
- The journey slide records a completed 'Rs 1 billion Rights Issue; initiated capacity expansion and cold-chain scale-up' - i.e. equity raised and deployed into the capacity and freezer build rather than returned.
- Management frames the model as internally funded across engines: 'Krishival Nuts providing a strong cash-generating foundation and Melt N Mellow emerging as the high-growth engine', with 'disciplined execution, prudent capital allocation'.
- Consolidated balance sheet at 31st Mar'26 vs 31st Mar'25 shows the reinvestment: Property, Plant & Equipment Rs 52.52 Cr vs Rs 33.35 Cr, Capital Work-in-progress Rs 10.55 Cr vs Rs 2.22 Cr, Cash and Cash Equivalents Rs 28.31 Cr vs Rs 14.65 Cr, Total Equity Rs 199.91 Cr vs Rs 141.69 Cr.
- Borrowings rose on both tenors: non-current Borrowings Rs 18.16 Cr vs Rs 10.69 Cr and current Borrowings Rs 17.20 Cr vs Rs 1.91 Cr at 31st Mar'26 vs 31st Mar'25 (quoted as the deck's two separate lines; the deck states no combined debt figure and no net-debt or leverage ratio).
- No dividend, buyback or payout policy is mentioned anywhere in the deck.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body: Nuts: Revenue ~INR 209 Cr (implied), 15% EBITDA margin, 10% PAT margin, 70% capacity utilization (existing 10 MT/day), targeting 90% in FY27. Ice Cream: Revenue ~INR 95 Cr, 7% EBITDA margin (ahead of plan), 1.7-1.8% PAT margin, 25% capacity utilization (1 lakh litres/day), targeting 100% by Q1 FY29. Ice Cream sales skewed to Q4 (INR 43 Cr in Q4 vs INR 47 Cr in first 9 months).

business.body:
| Challenge | Beneficiary/Loser | Dir | Conviction | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rising demand for branded healthy snacks and organized ice cream amid shift from unorganized sector; Need for cold chain expansion. | Krishival Foods Limited | beneficiary | High | Dual-engine model de-risks seasonality; Ice cream profitability achieved early; Clear path to 50% growth in FY27 with visible capacity roadmap. |
business.title: Challenges → beneficiaries & losers

business.body:
- Described as 'among India's fastest-growing FMCG companies, specialising in premium nuts, dry fruits, and ice cream', with company positioning stated as 'Leading presence in premium nuts & aspirational ice cream categories'.
- The two engines are framed as seasonally complementary: Q1 is seasonally strong for ice cream on summer demand while nuts sell more in Q2 and Q3 on festive demand, which management says gives 'greater balance to our revenue profile across the year, while also enabling more efficient working capital management'.
- Presence is concentrated in Western and Southern India - the footprint slide names Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Goa, Karnataka, Telangana (Hyderabad) and Andhra Pradesh - plus Singapore with 300+ retail touch-points.
- Scale markers cited: 34,200+ retail touch points for nuts & dry fruits, 11,000+ for ice cream, 300+ towns & places, customer retention over 80%, 200+ employees, over 12 years in the industry, and FSSAI / ISO / HACCP certifications.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Subsidiary structure] The ice cream business is run through subsidiary Melt N Mellow Foods Private Limited; the consolidated balance sheet carries a Non Controlling Interest of Rs 7.31 Cr at 31st Mar'26 (Rs 6.59 Cr at 31st Mar'25), and the deck does not state the ownership percentage.
- [Melt N Mellow milestone] The deck states Melt N Mellow 'Achieved EBITDA profitability in FY26, one year ahead of management's original target' and claims it is 'the only major emerging multi-state ice cream brand successfully scaling operations while remaining profitable'.
- [New market] Entered Andhra Pradesh through 3 CNF locations covering Rayalaseema, Vijayawada and Visakhapatnam, with the 1,780 freezers added in Q1 predominantly deployed there.
- [Headwinds] The deck flags external headwinds during the quarter: 'diesel availability constraints and higher milk prices'.
- [Exports] Singapore appears as a key market with 300+ retail touch-points, and the stated strategy is to 'Strengthen export footprint in Singapore, Japan & the US markets'.
business.title: Notable from the deck

latest_quarter.body: Raw material costs appeared elevated in Q4 due to mix shift toward ice cream (higher RMPM consumption); ESOP cost of INR 2.88 Cr in Q4 distorted margins; Future branding spend to be funded from incremental EBITDA to protect margins.
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

outlook.body: Revenue Growth: ~50% for FY27; Bottom-line Growth: 50%+ for FY27; Margins: Nuts steady-state 15%+ EBITDA/10%+ PAT; Ice Cream to reach 14-15% EBITDA at full capacity (Q1 FY29); Order Inflow: N/A; Capex/Commissioning: New 35k sq ft nuts unit commissioned April 2026; 2 lakh sq ft factory under construction.
outlook.title: Guidance

outlook.body: N/A for FMCG; Operational metrics: Ice Cream reached 34,200 retail outlets (15,490 deep freezers); Nuts reached 11,000 touchpoints; Total footprint 300+ Indian towns + Singapore.
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body: Mellow & Co. parlours (25 FOCO outlets in FY27 in Mumbai/Pune); Tier 2/3/4 penetration for Nuts; Premium SKUs launch in Ice Cream to counter seasonality; Targeting top 3 ice cream brand status in 7 years; Nuts targeting 10% market share.
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: Krishival Foods delivered 48% revenue growth in FY26 with the Melt N Mellow ice cream division achieving PAT profitability a year ahead of schedule (FY27 expected), validating the dual-engine model of stable nuts cash flow and high-growth indulgence. Management guides for 50%+ top-line and bottom-line growth in FY27, driven by capacity ramp-up and distribution deepening, though Q4 margins were temporarily impacted by one-off ESOP costs.
